item: Ring map: a late draw of an older group leaves the host in the newer pick's state
summary: A group's map that finishes drawing after a newer group was picked now leaves the host as the newer pick left it: the map of the newer group, or its loading line, its not-found line, its error, or empty after a cleared picker (the host note is kept in _ringHostNote and put back by the stale tail), and it still never writes its detail table. Node tests hold ooMap open for the loading, not-found, failed and detail cases (each guard mutation-checked: removing it fails a test); the wrapper's exact node total is 16 locale-free tests.
